meta.description: V40 (unidimensional): characteristic-curve scale linking (Haebara / Stocking-Lord, non-symmetric and symmetric) for 4PL, nominal and mixed 2PL + nominal common items.
meta.note: mirt does not implement IRT scale linking; each form is calibrated with mirt and the criteria, optima and Ogasawara (2001) delta-method covariances are computed in base R from the published formulas using mirt's probtrace() and expected.item().

meta.description: V40a: 4PL, J=12/form, 8 common, N=20000/group, target N(0,1), source N(0.5, 1.2^2)
V40b: nominal (K=4), J=12/form, 6 common, N=3000/group, target N(0,1), source N(0.5, 1.2^2)
V40c: mixed 2PL + nominal (K=3), J=15/form, 6+3 common, N=3000/group, source N(0.5, 1.2^2)
